description.value: A longitudinal study of associations between extrastriatal dopamine D2/3 receptor binding and cortical grey matter volume changes in first-episode schizophrenia patients before and after antipsychotic treatment.

spans.text: In a sample of initially antipsychotic-naïve first-episode schizophrenia patients, we investigated associations between extrastriatal dopamine D 2/3 receptor BP ND, blockade and grey matter volume changes before and after 3 months of antipsychotic treatment.
